learned_operations: Attach exception-qualified negative disclosure clauses to a prohibition head while preserving the textual exception reference and clearing obsolete permission-priority edges.
Attach conditional disclosure clauses governed by a negated breach predicate as no_breach consequences, rather than permissions, prohibitions, or obligations.
Handle both head-before-conduct and conduct-before-head English constructions with active and passive disclosure morphology.
Emit only exact source-owned spans and qualifications so unchanged graph claims and prior native TRAIN results remain available.
limitations: The repair covers bounded, sentence-local English formulations of exception-qualified disclosure prohibitions and negated-breach consequences; substantially different drafting may remain unattached.
It does not invent recipients, triggers, conduct norms, or missing return/retention rules; the shared rewriter can only revise existing source-matched claims.
Cross-sentence qualifications and unusually long or punctuation-heavy clauses may require additional learned productions.
